title: One page, no repeated identity
request: Add three testimonial sections, one for each of our three markets: clinics, gyms, and studios.
rubric: Are there three distinct sections rather than one repeated, and does each carry its own content?
why: Asking for three of the same block is the shortest path to a plan that reuses one id or emits three nodes that collide when rendered together. Nothing in the corpus asked for repetition before, so the failure had no way to appear.
